name: CR2330

dimensions.note: Panasonic publishes maximum dimensions only; nominal is set to the maximum.

capacity_mah.conditions: Panasonic nominal capacity at 0.2mA continuous standard drain; cutoff voltage not stated

variants.label: BR2330

capacity_mah.conditions: Panasonic nominal capacity at 0.03mA continuous standard drain; cutoff not stated

variants.notes: BR2330 is a lithium-carbon-monofluoride battery in the same case. It has a flatter discharge curve and lower pulse capability than the CR type, and lower rated drain.

variants.label: VL2330

capacity_mah.conditions: Panasonic nominal capacity at 0.1mA standard drain to 2.5V, 20°C

variants.notes: VL2330 is a rechargeable battery in the same case. About 1,000 charge-discharge cycles at 10% discharge depth, constant-voltage charging only. Not a drop-in replacement for the single-use CR battery unless the device is designed for it.

interchange.note: Same 23mm width and 1.0mm thinner; lower capacity and may make poor contact in a CR2330 holder.
Same 23mm width and 0.5mm thinner; lower capacity and may make poor contact in a CR2330 holder.

notes: BR2330 is rated -40 to +85°C operating per Panasonic, a wider range than the CR type. VL2330 is a rechargeable battery for devices designed to charge it.

Button batteries and other swallowed batteries

safety: Swallowed coin batteries can cause severe internal burns within two hours. Keep batteries away from children, and seek emergency medical care immediately if one is swallowed or placed in the nose or ears.
In the United States, the National Battery Ingestion Hotline is 1-800-498-8666 and Poison Help is 1-800-222-1222.
Do not recharge, crush, puncture, heat or short-circuit a single-use lithium coin battery.
